verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a hands-on community report of running Cua's own agent package (cua-agent 0.1.29, OMNI loop) with the small local model gemma3:4b. That suggests local-model operation is a supported path, but the runs were unreliable: one mistyped into the wrong place and two could not connect to the Computer API Server. The current first-party docs describe Cua Driver plugging into external agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, and never document local-model support. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of local model backends, evidence that device control works fully offline without a cloud API, current-version corroboration, and evidence of reliable task completion with a local model.
